annotations.title: Request a phone call to a business

description: Request that we call a business to confirm facts (opening hours, stock, prices, whether a contact exists) and return structured answers. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 7 per business called.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

phone_number.description: Phone number of the business (international format preferred).

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.
